q1.prompt: You are matching brackets in an expression. Which structure tracks the most recent unmatched opener?

choices.label: Stack — last unmatched opener is on top
Queue — process openers in arrival order

wrong_fifo.prompt: A queue would close the oldest opener first.
wrong_fifo.explanation: Bracket matching needs LIFO: the latest opener must close first. A queue serves FIFO and mismatches nested pairs.

q2.prompt: Which ordering requirement calls for another structure?

choices.label: When order must be first-in, first-out — that is a queue
Use a stack even when arrival order must be preserved

wrong_refuse.prompt: FIFO is not a stack job.
wrong_refuse.explanation: Avoid a stack when the order must be first-in, first-out — use a queue. Avoid recursion-plus-stack double bookkeeping when one stack is enough. Avoid popping without an empty check.

success.prompt: You matched LIFO to stacks and avoided them when FIFO is required.
